name: TreeAnnotator
description: Summarises a BEAST posterior tree sample into a single Maximum Clade Credibility tree with annotated node statistics.
citation: Rambaut A. and Drummond A.J. TreeAnnotator v1.10, 2002-2017.

fields.label: Burn-in (states)
fields.help: Number of MCMC states to discard as burn-in. Mutually exclusive with -burninTrees.

fields.label: Burn-in (trees)
fields.help: Number of trees to discard as burn-in. Mutually exclusive with -burnin.

fields.label: Node heights
fields.help: How to set node heights on the summary tree: keep (from MCC topology), median, mean, or common ancestor (ca).

fields.label: Target tree file
fields.help: User-supplied target tree to annotate instead of the MCC tree.

fields.label: Posterior probability limit
fields.help: Minimum posterior probability for a node to be annotated.

fields.label: Force discrete traits
fields.help: Treat integer-valued traits as discrete rather than continuous when summarising.

fields.label: 2D HPD proportion(s)
fields.help: Comma-separated HPD proportions for 2D spatial trait summaries.

fields.label: Input trees file
fields.help: BEAST posterior tree sample (.trees file) to summarise.

fields.label: Output file
fields.help: Path for the annotated MCC tree output file.
